fields.why: The brief says age and sex are recorded always; both cases give age and sex ('A 53-year-old incarcerated man', 'a woman in Georgia'), which B left out.

Homelessness and incarceration are listed as one patient's individual TB risk factors (why he got LTBI treatment), not offered as explanations of the reported outcome or of any group difference. The brief should say whether individual SES risk factors in a case history count as determinants.

brief_issues: determinants_of_health does not say whether SES items named as individual risk factors in a case report count as determinants.
